text:
incident_bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: sudden surge in authz-cache misses and throttling observed for hosted API in us-west-2 and eu-west-1. Error-rate on /v1/chat up ~4%. Paging oncall.
morgan_oncall: seeing high 429s coming from authz-proxy with logs showing `cache-miss -> backend-throttle`. Query: `rate(authz_cache_misses[1m])` spiking.
lee_sre: grabbing traces. Correlation: increased size of policy documents after recent org-policy change; cache keys grew and eviction rate jumped. Sample log:
```
[2026-04-12T11:05:04Z] authz-proxy: cache_evictions=578 miss_rate=0.67 key_size_bytes=12400
```
rachel_prod: status page created: https://status.redwood.example/incidents/1771001122 1 - Impact: elevated 429/502 for hosted API in NA/EU. Mitigation in progress.
kevin_api: temporarily disable strict throttle for authz-proxy when cache backend reports evictions>300/s (feature-flag). Enabling on a 2-node canary now.
support_lead: customers reporting rate-limit errors when sending multi-turn chats. Sending interim note pointing to status page and advising retries with backoff.
infra_eng: scaled up authz-cache cluster by +30% capacity and increased max_entry_size to accommodate larger keys. Monitoring impact.
morgan_oncall: canary nodes show miss-rate drop and fewer 429s; overall 429s down ~60% within 90s on canary path. Rolling flag to remaining nodes.
lee_sre: root cause hypothesis: org-policy change introduced large JSON blobs for certain organizational policies which exceeded our cache key size expectations causing fragmentation and high eviction churn.
rachel_prod: drafting customer advisory and internal postmortem stub. Status updated: "Mitigation: capacity increased and throttle loosened; monitoring. Action items created."
infra_eng: adding longer-term fixes: 1) normalize policy blobs before hashing into cache key, 2) increase default cache entry size threshold, 3) add alert for cache_key_size > 8KB for >1% of requests.
kevin_api: note: loosening throttle increases risk of backend load; watching backend error-rate. If backend heat increases we'll add short-term rate limit per-org to protect core systems.
support_lead: escalated two high-priority customer tickets to SRE for manual retries; customers appreciate the real-time updates.
morgan_oncall: final update: rolling config applied to all authz-proxy nodes; miss and eviction metrics returned to baseline. 429 and 502 rates back to normal.
incident_bot: RESOLVED signal at 1771001880 1 - incident closed. Postmortem ticket: https://redwood.internal/pm/1771001122-postmortem
